text:
elaine: Heads-up: I'm finalizing a docs PR that replaces several older audit-log examples. Need a concise tenant-scoped JSONL sample, a CLI export command for the docs, and SOC2-friendly retention wording before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/503

samir: drop the JSONL sample here and i'll add it to the snippet file. also tell me which phrasing lex/legal prefers for retention.

elaine: prefer short bullets under Compliance > Audit Logs: default retention, privileged logs retention, and note about customer exports. For the sample, keep it 1-line JSONL showing tenant_id and event_type.

ben: add a tiny comment in the sample about filtering by tenant_id and event_type. keeps customers from exporting everything accidentally.

samir: sample (single JSONL line) -> paste as-is into docs/snippets/audit/sample-event.jsonl:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-02T09:12:03Z","event_type":"auth.login","tenant_id":"team-eden","actor":"user:bob","resource":"/api/v1/models","meta":{"ip":"203.0.113.5","success":true}}
```

elaine: nice. i'll use that.

maria: legal note: don't state absolute deletion guarantees. prefer 'default retention period' language and mention contractual exceptions and legal holds. also ensure we call out that secrets/credentials are never logged in plaintext.

lex-legal: suggested copy: "Default audit logs are retained for 90 days. Privileged events (audit of access/permission changes) are retained for 180 days. Customers may request different retention via contract; legal holds and regulatory obligations may supersede deletion policies. Exported snapshots initiated by customers are considered customer-controlled data." Thoughts?

ben: looks good. maybe swap the order so privileged logs appear as a separate bullet.

elaine: will format as three bullets: default 90d, privileged 180d, exports are customer-controlled + contact AM to extend. also short Q/A: 'Can I extend retention?' -> 'Yes, via contract; contact your account manager.'

samir: CLI export example for docs:
```bash
# export tenant-scoped audit events (last 30 days)
ri audit export --tenant team-eden --from 2026-02-01 --to 2026-03-02 --format jsonl --out ./team-eden-audit-30d.jsonl
```

samir: small SDK helper snippets also ready; i'll add links to docs/snippets/ruby/audit_count.rb and docs/snippets/go/audit_count.go rather than inline full code.

maria: confirm whether exported snapshots are stored by Redwood by default. if not, we should say 'we do not alter customer exports; retention is customer-managed'.

lex-legal: agreed. add this exact sentence to avoid ambiguity: "We do not alter customer exports; retention of exported snapshots is managed by the customer."

elaine: added. final checklist: update PR with JSONL sample link, CLI snippet, two SDK snippet links, SOC2 bullet wording (lex-legal text), and run docs unit test that parses the sample.

ben: quick nit: use labels 'Default retention' and 'Privileged retention' as headings in the bullets so it's easier to scan.

deploy-bot: PR 503 merged to staging at 3176550048 by @elaine :white_check_mark:

elaine: i'll hold merging to prod until lex-legal + maria give final ok on wording. thanks all, ping me if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
